page.layout: One column of index entries in two-line items, with page numbers at the right; a section letter (E., F., G.) above each group; at the foot a letter "L." with the start of the next word, "La-", at the right.
page.notes: The running head at the top is faded and cut off, so I have left it out. No page number is visible. The "Lacedæmoniis" ligature is doubtful and may be printed as "Lacedaemoniis" [?]. The initial letters E, F and G are large display letters joined to the following word. The "La-" at the foot is taken as a catchword.
